title: Embedding quantization sanity harness and cosine guardrails for INT8/FP8 calibration
creator: Maya Chen
description: Deliver a reproducible 'sanity harness' and runbook for embedding model quantization (INT8 and experimental FP8) that pairs offline calibration sweeps with continuous cosine-similarity drift checks. This ticket defines the calibration workflow, per-bucket profiling, delta thresholds, and an automated validation pipeline with actionable guardrails so model maintainers can safely roll quantized embedding artifacts into Serving and Dedicated fleets. The goal is to prevent silent retrieval regressions by combining vector-space checks (cosine similarity distributions) with task-level signals (recall@K on canonical eval sets).
tasks: Design calibration dataset buckets by sequence length, token distribution, and domain (web/docs/chat) — ensure representativeness for production workloads
Implement offline calibration runner that generates per-channel scales for INT8 and per-tensor/FP8 alternatives; expose metadata for runtime selection
Add cosine similarity baseline job: compute pairwise cosines vs FP32 baseline for a fixed seed set; capture histograms and top-K delta metrics
Create continuous drift detector: rolling EMAs of mean_cosine_drop and p95_cosine_drop, with configurable thresholds and cooldowns
Integrate shadow-run mode into Dedicated/Demo fleets to collect live cosines and downstream retrieval metrics without affecting traffic
Build validation report generator (HTML + JSON) with recommended rollback/fallback actions when thresholds are exceeded
Document runbook and auto-remediation steps (canary rollback, fallback to FP16, alerting channels)
Add unit/integration tests for calibration runner and cosine comparator; attach to CI gating for quantized artifact promotion
acceptance_criteria: Offline calibration produces stable INT8 and FP8 candidate artifacts with per-bucket scale metadata and reproducible outputs on the calibration seed set
Validation pipeline computes baseline FP32->quantized cosine histograms and flags quantized artifacts when mean_cosine_drop > 0.015 or recall@10 drop > 1.5% (configurable)
Automated report includes: per-bucket drift table, top 10 outlier queries, and suggested mitigation (re-run calibration with per-channel granularity or fallback to FP16)
Shadow-run collects live cosine and retrieval metrics for at least 24h on Dedicated pool and surfaces them in Grafana dashboard
PRs for calibration runner and validator merged and gated by CI with acceptance tests

qa_plan: Unit tests for calibration math (quant/dequant) with random seeds and fixed fixtures
Integration test that compares quantized embedding outputs to FP32 baseline on the canonical seed set (CI job run every PR)
End-to-end shadow-run verification: compare recall@10 and mAP over 24/72h windows and assert no regression above configured thresholds
Chaos scenario: simulate distribution shift (mix of short/long sequences) and verify detector triggers and report quality
notes: Decision: Use per-channel INT8 by default; FP8 remain behind feature flag for now due to lack of hardware parity across Dedicated customers
Trade-off: tighter cosine thresholds reduce risk but increase calibration iteration count; proposed defaults aim for balanced operational cost
Follow-up: coordinate with Docs for a short 'Quantized Embeddings Safety' page outlining rollback steps and threshold rationale
